description: This source file defines a singleton class 'VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync' responsible for synchronizing voice wake settings with a remote gateway. It manages starting and stopping background tasks, handling incoming event streams, and updating application state accordingly.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing synchronization of voice wake settings with a remote service, handling event streams, and updating app state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the background task to continuously refresh and subscribe to voice wake events from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake triggers from the gateway and applies them to the app state.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Handles incoming push events, decodes payloads, and updates the application state if relevant events are received.
